- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?
<!-- Add a one line overview of what this PR aims to accomplish. -->

Adds `MLAWithLatentCP`, an experimental MLA self-attention variant whose context parallelism exchanges the **compressed KV latent** (`kv_lora_rank + qk_pos_emb_head_dim` channels, 576 for Kimi-K3) between CP ranks instead of the up-projected K/V. Each ring step re-runs the inherited `linear_kv_up_proj` on the received latent, attends, and merges the partial outputs in fp32; backward re-circulates `(latent, dlatent)` pairs and recomputes the up-projection per step, so no full K/V is ever saved. Core attention calls the public Transformer Engine `fused_attn_fwd/bwd` (cuDNN) or FlashAttention-4 directly, selected by the existing `attention_backend` flag. The existing MLA path is untouched; no TE private function is used.

Enabled by `TransformerConfig.mla_latent_cp=True` (GPT decoder specs and the hybrid stack, MTP included). Supports THD packed/padded input in the zigzag CP layout, causal MLA with RoPE as in `MLASelfAttention` and with the output gate, TP with sequence parallelism, CP=1, dynamic CP (p2p mode), `cp_comm_type` `p2p` / `a2a` / `a2a+p2p` (Ulysses stage over the hierarchical a2a group with the up-projection sliced to the rank's heads), fused weight-gradient accumulation, MXFP8 including quantized parameters. Unsupported combinations are rejected in `TransformerConfig.__post_init__`. Contiguous CP input for MLA depends on #7545 (MLA input-layout conversion); `dev` already rejects `cp_partition_mode=contiguous` with MLA.

## Why

For long-context MLA training the CP ring moves full K/V (≈ 0.5 GB per hop at 512K tokens / CP16) and TE's wrapper keeps all P receive buffers alive through the forward. Exchanging the latent cuts the payload 13× and lets each step's buffers die immediately; attention backends can be called directly (FlashAttention-4 is not reachable through TE's CP ring). The latent approach has a structural cost — K/V must be rebuilt per ring step — which the optimizations below pay back.

## Optimizations (in the order they were added; effects measured on the proxy below)

1. **Latent payload, per-step up-projection recompute**: ring payload 503 MB → 38 MB per hop; peak reserved memory −6.4 GB; structural cost ≈ +1 s recompute and ≈ +2.4 s K/V assembly per step at 16 ring steps.
2. **Direct core-attention calls** (cuDNN via TE's public API, or FA4): TE's private THD correction kernels gone (−0.85 s); FA4's backward is 9–11% faster per launch than cuDNN at these shapes (qk 192 / v 128) → −2.9 s/step vs the cuDNN latent ring. FA4 is only available under CP through this path.
3. **fp32 online-softmax merge** as one fused in-place kernel per step; the final merged output/LSE is reused for every backward step (no per-step correction).
4. **One TP all-gather of the latent before the ring, one reduce-scatter after** instead of per-step SP collectives inside the TE linear: −1.5 s of compute-stream NCCL kernel time.
5. **K/V assembly as one autograd Function** with strided copies in both directions (avoids `cat` with a stride-0 operand and the unvectorised split-backward cat): ≈ −2.3 s of kernel time.
6. **Up-projection parameters as Function inputs**: one `AccumulateGrad` / DDP hook per parameter per microbatch, which dynamic CP and DDP bucket readiness require.
7. **`a2a+p2p` and `a2a`**: latent all-gathered over the a2a group, queries/outputs exchanged tokens↔heads, gathered chunks permuted into the zigzag of the p2p group; the ring runs unchanged with P/A steps on H/A heads. All per-step costs shrink with the step count and the attention kernels work on A× larger problems: 70.5 → 67.6 s ([4,4]).
8. **Head-sliced up-projection in a2a modes**: the TE module projects only the rank's H/A heads through a row slab of its weight (zero-copy view, swapped in by a per-call pre-hook after DDP's parameter all-gather completes); gradients map back to the full weight: −0.9 s at [4,4]; **66.1 s at [8,2]**.
9. **Two-stream forward ring** (TE's `cp_stream` pattern) kept behind `mla_latent_cp_two_stream` (default off): measured neutral at 64K–512K on GB300.

## Results

Kimi-K3 9-layer proxy, packed THD 512K tokens, 64 × GB300 (TP4 + sequence parallel, CP16, EP64, MXFP8, Muon, MTP1, selective recompute + fine-grained offload); step time = mean of 7 iterations after one warm-up iteration, one run per configuration; the old path is the existing `MLASelfAttention` → TE context-parallel attention (cuDNN; TE's ring has no FA4 branch). Per-iteration times of the new path are below the old path's corresponding iterations in every FA4 configuration.

| configuration | step (s) | vs old p2p | TFLOP/s/GPU | peak allocated / reserved (GB) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| old path, `p2p` (cuDNN) | 71.01 | — | 833 | 69.0 / 83.5 |
| old path, `a2a+p2p` [4,4] (cuDNN) | 68.36 | −3.7% | 865 | 69.2 / 79.4 |
| old path, `a2a+p2p` [8,2] (cuDNN) | 67.38 | −5.1% | 878 | 69.2 / 78.6 |
| latent CP, `p2p`, cuDNN | 73.43 | +3.4% | 805 | 69.0 / 78.2 |
| latent CP, `p2p`, FA4 | 70.51 | −0.7% | 839 | 69.0 / 77.1 |
| latent CP, `a2a+p2p` [4,4], FA4 | 66.66 | −6.1% | 887 | 69.0 / 77.2 |
| **latent CP, `a2a+p2p` [8,2], FA4** | **66.10** | **−6.9%** | **895** | **69.0 / 77.1** |

`[A, P/A]` = `hierarchical_context_parallel_sizes`. TE's own hierarchical scheme also prefers [8,2]; against that best old configuration the new path is 1.3 s (−1.9%) faster, with 1.5 GB less reserved memory, and faster in every iteration (by 0.6–1.8 s). Peak allocated is reached outside MLA and is unchanged; the reserved and device-used savings (−6.4 GB / −5.4 GB vs the old p2p path, −1.5 GB / −1.7 GB vs old [8,2]) come from freeing ring buffers per step. Pure `a2a` needs heads-per-TP-rank divisible by the CP size (not possible at CP16 with 24 heads); at 64K/CP4 it is the fastest mode (20.64 s vs 20.89 s old).

**Full model.** With the feature squashed onto the Kimi-K3 preview stack and re-measured with same-commit pairs (same container, mock data, GBS 32, MTP1), the gain carries over to the full model:

| model | parallel layout | old path: TE `p2p`, cuDNN | latent CP `a2a+p2p` [8,2], FA4 | Δ step | TFLOP/s/GPU |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Kimi-K3 full model (93 decoder blocks)**, THD 512K | TP4 PP4 EP64 CP16, 256 × GB300 | 169.2 s | **157.9 s** | **−6.7%** | 715 → **766** |
| 9-layer proxy, THD 512K | TP4 PP1 EP64 CP16, 64 × GB300 | 69.93 ± 0.23 s | **65.50 ± 0.30 s** | **−6.3%** (faster in every paired step) | 846 → **903** |

Peak allocated memory is unchanged on both (164 GB on the full model's first pipeline stage), reserved memory −4.8 GB (full) / −6.4 GB (proxy), and the mock-data loss trajectories are identical to MXFP8 rerun noise. At 64K with CP2 the pure `a2a` mode replaces the ring entirely: 18.8 → 18.5 s/step on real data with parity 2.69e-4.

![Step time and throughput, old TE p2p ring vs latent CP a2a+p2p [8,2] + FA4, 9-layer proxy and full model](37_latent_cp_speedup.png)

**Numerics.** Real-data resume parity (THD 64K, 32 steps, same checkpoint and data) against the old path: max |Δ lm loss| 1.4–1.9e-4 across the modes (`p2p` cuDNN 1.42e-4, `p2p` FA4 1.91e-4, `a2a+p2p` 1.63e-4, `a2a` 1.89e-4), run-to-run floor ≈ 1e-4, no NaN/skipped steps; on the integrated stack `a2a+p2p` [2,2] 2.32e-4 and pure `a2a` (CP2) 2.69e-4, at the proxy's own rerun floor.

**Profile audit (nsys, one step).** Kernels present only in the new path are its own ring ops (fused fp32 merge, padding-row mask, second-chunk index ops, strided K/V copies, fp32 accumulates, a2a split/cat and permutation index ops) and the FA4 kernels; TE's private `thd_*` correction/half-read/reorder kernels and the cuDNN fusion helpers disappear; ≈ 280–290 of ≈ 320–330 shared kernels have identical launch counts, the rest being the per-ring-step up-projection group and NCCL op counts. GPU idle and exposed communication are unchanged across configurations. Host time of the ring per layer-microbatch: 5 / 9 ms (fwd / bwd) at [8,2] vs 24 / 25 ms for the TE wrapper.

Also explored and not included: a latent **all-gather** CP scheme (no ring, two prefix-attention calls per rank). It reaches 69.3 s at 512K but raises peak allocated memory by 24 GB, because every rank rebuilds K/V for the whole sequence and all heads; the code is kept on a side branch.

## Tests

`tests/unit_tests/transformer/experimental_attention_variant/test_mla_latent_cp.py` compares the old and new paths on identical weights, inputs and upstream gradients (outputs and all parameter gradients): TP × CP layouts up to 8 GPUs, packed and padded THD, CP=1, dynamic CP, separate KV norm, MXFP8 with bf16 and quantized parameters (including the head-slab path), fused weight-gradient accumulation, `a2a`/`a2a+p2p` including odd head counts, two-stream mode, FA4-vs-cuDNN; it also exercises the zero-copy half-KV ring step and the a2a permutation directly (CPU) and covers the config/construction/spec guards. On GB300 (TE 2.20 container): 54 passed / 9 skipped on one 4-GPU node (skips are 8-GPU cases), 9 passed on 2 nodes; the MLA/attention/GPT/hybrid regression groups are identical on `dev` with and without this branch.

## Notes for reviewers

- Only `megatron/core/transformer/experimental_attention_variant/mla_latent_cp.py` (new) plus small gated edits: `TransformerConfig.mla_latent_cp` / `mla_latent_cp_two_stream` (+ validation), the spec swap in `get_gpt_decoder_layer_specs` and `HybridStack.__init__`, and a one-line reset of the hierarchical CP groups in `parallel_state.destroy_model_parallel`.
- FA4 is driven through `flash_attn.cute.interface._flash_attn_fwd/_bwd` (FA4 has no public split API), pinned to `flash_attn_4==4.0.0b11` and SM100+; cuDNN remains the default (`attention_backend=fused`/`auto`).
- Dynamic CP is supported for `p2p`; the `a2a` modes reject it (MCore has no hierarchical variant of the per-microbatch CP groups).
- The measured results come from an internal proxy setup that depends on a preview branch and is not reproducible on `dev` as is; the unit tests are the validation that runs here.

Opened as a draft per the repository rule.

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+"""Experimental MLA context parallelism that exchanges the latent KV between CP ranks.
+
+``MLAWithLatentCP`` keeps everything of ``MLASelfAttention`` except core attention. The latent KV
+of the local sequence shard (``kv_lora_rank + qk_pos_emb_head_dim`` channels, gathered over the
+tensor/sequence-parallel group once) travels around the CP ring in a zigzag schedule; every step
+re-runs the inherited ``linear_kv_up_proj`` on the received latent, attends to it, and merges the
+partial outputs in fp32. Backward re-circulates ``(latent, dlatent)`` pairs and recomputes the
+up-projection per step, so no full K/V is ever saved. Core attention runs directly on the public
+Transformer Engine ``fused_attn_fwd/bwd`` (cuDNN) or FlashAttention-4 kernels instead of TE's
+attention wrapper, selectable per direction (``mla_latent_cp_fwd_backend`` /
+``mla_latent_cp_bwd_backend``; default ``attention_backend``). THD packed input in the zigzag CP
+layout, causal self-attention. RoPE is applied as in ``MLASelfAttention``: the query's and the
+latent's positional channels are rotated once before the ring; a parent that marks a layer
+RoPE-free (``use_rope=False``) skips it. A contiguous CP layout for MLA depends on the input
+conversion of PR #7545.
+
+``cp_comm_type`` ``a2a+p2p`` (hierarchical CP groups) and ``a2a`` add a Ulysses stage over the a2a
+group: the latents of its ``A`` ranks are gathered, query tokens are exchanged for heads, and the
+gathered block is reordered into the zigzag of the p2p group (natural order for pure ``a2a``), so
+the ring runs unchanged with ``A``-times longer steps on ``H/A`` heads (``P/A`` steps).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import inspect
+from contextlib import contextmanager, nullcontext
+from importlib.metadata import PackageNotFoundError, version
+from typing import NamedTuple, Optional
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
+from megatron.core.extensions.transformer_engine import HAVE_TE
+from megatron.core.jit import jit_fuser
+from megatron.core.models.common.embeddings.rope_utils import apply_rotary_pos_emb
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.mappings import (
+    all_to_all_hp2sp,
+    all_to_all_sp2hp,
+    gather_from_sequence_parallel_region,
+)
+from megatron.core.transformer.enums import AttnBackend, AttnMaskType
+from megatron.core.transformer.identity_op import IdentityOp
+from megatron.core.transformer.multi_latent_attention import MLASelfAttention
+from megatron.core.transformer.spec_utils import ModuleSpec
+from megatron.core.typed_torch import apply_module
+from megatron.core.utils import get_pg_size
+
+if HAVE_TE:
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch import LayerNormLinear, Linear
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.cpp_extensions.fused_attn import (
+        FusedAttnBackend,
+        fused_attn_bwd,
+        fused_attn_fwd,
+    )
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.distributed import activation_recompute_forward
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.fp8 import FP8GlobalStateManager, fp8_autocast
+
+    # Older TE builds lack the THD layout keywords; their defaults would silently mean sbhd.
+    _FUSED_ATTN_API_OK = {"o_format", "cu_seqlens_q_padded"} <= set(
+        inspect.signature(fused_attn_fwd).parameters
+    ) and {"o_format", "do_format", "dqkv_layout", "deterministic"} <= set(
+        inspect.signature(fused_attn_bwd).parameters
+    )
+else:
+    _FUSED_ATTN_API_OK = False
+
+# FlashAttention-4 has no public split forward/backward API; the module drives the two entry
+# points its own autograd function uses, pinned to the version they were validated against.
+_FA4_VERSION = "4.0.0b11"
+_FA4 = None
+
+
+def apply_mla_latent_cp_spec(attn_spec: ModuleSpec) -> ModuleSpec:
+    """Return a copy of an MLA self-attention spec that builds ``MLAWithLatentCP``.
+
+    The copy swaps the module class and replaces ``core_attention`` with ``IdentityOp`` (the TE
+    attention wrapper is never built). The input spec is not modified.
+    """
+    spec = copy.deepcopy(attn_spec)
+    spec.module = MLAWithLatentCP
+    spec.submodules.core_attention = IdentityOp
+    return spec
+
+
+class _Step(NamedTuple):
+    """One ring step. ``cu_*`` are actual cumulative lengths, ``off_*`` padded token offsets."""
+
+    upper: bool  # local second chunk only (compact rows) vs. all local queries
+    cu_q: torch.Tensor
+    cu_kv: torch.Tensor
+    off_q: torch.Tensor
+    off_kv: torch.Tensor
+    max_q: int
+    max_kv: int
+    causal: bool
+
+
+class _StepPlan(NamedTuple):
+    """THD metadata of the zigzag ring on one CP rank (device int32, no host synchronisation).
+
+    Every local sequence is stored as ``[first chunk | second chunk]`` of equal padded length;
+    rank ``r`` owns chunks ``r`` and ``2P-1-r`` of each packed sequence. Step ``i`` attends to the
+    latent of owner ``(r - i) mod P``: all local queries against both owner chunks (step 0,
+    causal), against the owner's first chunk only (owner before this rank; zero copy through the
+    full offsets with half lengths), or the local second chunk against both owner chunks.
+    """
+
+    steps: list[_Step]  # forward ring order; backward walks it in reverse
+    rows: Optional[torch.Tensor]  # [T/2] int64 rows of this rank's second chunks (upper steps)
+    valid: Optional[torch.Tensor]  # [T] bool actual-token rows (None without padded cu_seqlens)
+
+
+def _build_step_plan(packed_seq_params, cp_size: int, cp_rank: int, num_tokens: int) -> _StepPlan:
+    """Derive the ring metadata from the global THD ``cu_seqlens`` (actual and padded)."""
+    cu = packed_seq_params.cu_seqlens_q
+    cup = packed_seq_params.cu_seqlens_q_padded
+    padded = cup is not None
+    if not padded:
+        cup = cu
+    device = cu.device
+    off_local = torch.div(cup, cp_size, rounding_mode="floor")
+    off_half = torch.div(off_local, 2, rounding_mode="floor")
+    half = off_half[1:] - off_half[:-1]
+    seqlens = cu[1:] - cu[:-1]
+    owners = torch.arange(cp_size, device=device, dtype=cu.dtype).unsqueeze(1)
+    # Actual tokens in chunk c of a sequence with s actual tokens: clamp(s - c * half, 0, half).
+    first = torch.minimum((seqlens - owners * half).clamp_(min=0), half)
+    second = torch.minimum((seqlens - (2 * cp_size - 1 - owners) * half).clamp_(min=0), half)
+
+    def cumsum0(lengths):
+        return F.pad(torch.cumsum(lengths, dim=-1, dtype=torch.int32), (1, 0))
+
+    act_full, act_first, act_second = cumsum0(first + second), cumsum0(first), cumsum0(second)
+    L = int(packed_seq_params.max_seqlen_q) // cp_size
+    steps = []
+    for i in range(cp_size):
+        owner = (cp_rank - i) % cp_size
+        if i == 0:
+            step = _Step(
+                False, act_full[cp_rank], act_full[owner], off_local, off_local, L, L, True
+            )
+        elif i <= cp_rank:
+            step = _Step(
+                False, act_full[cp_rank], act_first[owner], off_local, off_local, L, L // 2, False
+            )
+        else:
+            step = _Step(
+                True, act_second[cp_rank], act_full[owner], off_half, off_local, L // 2, L, False
+            )
+        steps.append(step)
+
+    rows = valid = None
+    if cp_rank < cp_size - 1:
+        # Row index of the local second chunks in the compact second-half layout; the sum of
+        # ``half`` is num_tokens // 2 for MCore THD batches (every tail is a padded sequence).
+        n_half = num_tokens // 2
+        reps = half.to(torch.int64)
+        starts = torch.repeat_interleave(off_local[:-1] + half, reps, output_size=n_half)
+        bases = torch.repeat_interleave(off_half[:-1], reps, output_size=n_half)
+        rows = starts.to(torch.int64) + torch.arange(n_half, device=device) - bases.to(torch.int64)
+    if padded:
+        f, s = first[cp_rank], second[cp_rank]
+        lens = torch.stack([f, half - f, s, half - s], dim=1).reshape(-1).to(torch.int64)
+        pattern = torch.tensor([True, False, True, False], device=device).repeat(half.numel())
+        valid = torch.repeat_interleave(pattern, lens, output_size=num_tokens)
+    return _StepPlan(steps=steps, rows=rows, valid=valid)
+
+
+class _Permute(torch.autograd.Function):
+    """Row permutation by ``index_select`` in both directions (no ``index_add`` atomics)."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(ctx, x, perm, inv):
+        ctx.inv = inv
+        return x.index_select(0, perm)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def backward(ctx, grad):
+        return grad.index_select(0, ctx.inv), None, None
+
+
+def _a2a_permutation(packed_seq_params, cp_size: int, a2a_size: int, num_tokens: int):
+    """Row index from the rank-major gather over the a2a group to the ring's sequence order.
+
+    The gather yields ``A`` blocks of ``num_tokens`` rows, block ``a`` = source rank ``a``'s
+    sequence-major ``[first | second]`` THD block. Sequence order per sequence is
+    ``[first(0) … first(A-1) | second(A-1) … second(0)]`` (global chunk ids ascending in both
+    halves): the zigzag of the p2p group with chunk size ``A * c`` (natural order for pure a2a).
+    Returns ``(perm, inv)`` with ``x.index_select(0, perm)`` in sequence order; device int64, no
+    host synchronisation.
+    """
+    cup = packed_seq_params.cu_seqlens_q_padded
+    if cup is None:
+        cup = packed_seq_params.cu_seqlens_q
+    device = cup.device
+    off_local = torch.div(cup, cp_size, rounding_mode="floor")  # [B+1] per-rank padded offsets
+    c = torch.div(off_local[1:] - off_local[:-1], 2, rounding_mode="floor")  # [B] chunk length
+    slots = torch.arange(2 * a2a_size, device=device)  # [2A] target slots within a sequence
+    src_rank = torch.where(slots < a2a_size, slots, 2 * a2a_size - 1 - slots)
+    src_half = (slots >= a2a_size).to(src_rank.dtype)
+    # Start row of (sequence i, slot k) in the target and in the rank-major source.
+    dst = (a2a_size * off_local[:-1])[:, None] + slots[None, :] * c[:, None]
+    src = src_rank[None, :] * num_tokens + off_local[:-1][:, None] + src_half[None, :] * c[:, None]
+    reps = c.to(torch.int64).repeat_interleave(2 * a2a_size)
+    pos = torch.arange(a2a_size * num_tokens, device=device)
+    shift = torch.repeat_interleave((src - dst).reshape(-1), reps, output_size=pos.numel())
+    perm = pos + shift
+    return perm, torch.argsort(perm)
+
+
+# Backend shims. fwd(q, k, v, step, scale) -> (out bf16 [n, H, dv], lse fp32 [n, H], rng_state);
+# bwd(q, k, v, out, dout, lse, rng, step, scale, deterministic) -> (dq, dk, dv).
+# The two directions may come from different backends: a backward only needs the merged output
+# and its log-sum-exp, which both kernels keep as the natural-log LSE of the scaled scores (cuDNN's
+# softmax stats, FlashAttention's lse); without dropout the rng state is a placeholder.
+
+
+def _lengths(cu):
+    return cu[1:] - cu[:-1]
+
+
+def _mask(step):
+    return "padding_causal" if step.causal else "padding"
+
+
+def _cudnn_fwd(q, k, v, step, scale):
+    out, aux = fused_attn_fwd(
+        True,
+        step.max_q,
+        step.max_kv,
+        step.cu_q,

+    """Online-softmax merge in place: fold ``(out_i, lse_i)`` into the fp32 accumulators."""
+    lse_new = torch.logaddexp(lse, lse_i)
+    out.mul_(torch.exp(lse - lse_new).unsqueeze(-1))
+    out.addcmul_(out_i, torch.exp(lse_i - lse_new).unsqueeze(-1))

+def _p2p(ring, sends, recvs, forward):
+    """Post one batched send/recv along the ring (forward: to r+1 from r-1; backward: reversed)."""
+    dst, src = (ring.nxt, ring.prv) if forward else (ring.prv, ring.nxt)
+    send_ops = [dist.P2POp(dist.isend, t, dst, ring.group) for t in sends]
+    recv_ops = [dist.P2POp(dist.irecv, t, src, ring.group) for t in recvs]
+    return dist.batch_isend_irecv(
+        send_ops + recv_ops if ring.rank % 2 == 0 else recv_ops + send_ops
+    )

+def _streams(two_stream):
+    """``[current, side]`` when ``two_stream`` (opt-in, ``config.mla_latent_cp_two_stream``):
+    alternating ring steps run on the two streams (TE's ``cp_stream`` pattern) so adjacent
+    attention kernels overlap; otherwise ``[current, current]``, and the ring's events and
+    ``record_stream`` are no-ops. The side stream is private to this module; every entry waits on
+    the current stream and every exit joins it back, so tensors allocated on either stream may be
+    read on the other without ``record_stream`` as long as they are freed only after an exit
+    (``q``, ``out``, ``lse``, ``rng_states``, the saved latent)."""
+    global _SIDE_STREAM
+    current = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+    if not two_stream:
+        return [current, current]
+    if _SIDE_STREAM is None:
+        _SIDE_STREAM = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    _SIDE_STREAM.wait_stream(current)
+    return [current, _SIDE_STREAM]

+@contextmanager
+def _without_tp_comm(linear):
+    """Run one call of a TE column-parallel linear on an already gathered input.
+
+    TE reads ``parallel_mode`` per call; ``None`` skips the sequence-parallel input all-gather and
+    the gradient reduce-scatter while the GEMM, quantization and fused weight gradient are
+    unchanged. The ring gathers the latent once and reduce-scatters its gradient once instead.
+    Every call of this module's ``linear_kv_up_proj`` goes through here (TE's
+    ``input_quantizer.optimize_for_gemm`` stays set).
+    """
+    saved = linear.parallel_mode
+    linear.parallel_mode = None
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        linear.parallel_mode = saved

+class _Slab:
+    """Rows ``[r0, r1)`` of a TE linear's weight as a leaf Parameter that the module reads as its
+    weight for one call (TE takes its shapes from it), so it projects only those output rows; it
+    carries the full parameter's ``main_grad`` rows and fused-wgrad flag, so TE accumulates where
+    the full parameter would. A view in bf16 and TE's zero-copy ``split`` of the quantized data
+    and scales for an MXFP8 parameter (padded scales are copied), built on first use by a forward
+    pre-hook registered per call, i.e. after DDP's hook has waited for the weight's all-gather.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, r0, r1):
+        self.r0, self.r1, self.param = r0, r1, None
+
+    def __call__(self, linear, _):
+        if self.param is None:
+            weight, n = linear.weight, self.r1 - self.r0
+            self.param = torch.nn.Parameter(
+                torch.split(weight.detach(), n)[self.r0 // n], weight.requires_grad
+            )
+            if hasattr(weight, "main_grad"):
+                self.param.main_grad = weight.main_grad[self.r0 : self.r1]
+            if hasattr(weight, "grad_added_to_main_grad"):
+                self.param.grad_added_to_main_grad = False
+        linear._parameters["weight"] = self.param
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def _weight_slab(linear, slab):
+    """Let one TE call read ``slab`` as the module's weight (swapped in by the slab's hook)."""
+    if slab is None:
+        yield
+        return
+    full, handle = linear.weight, linear.register_forward_pre_hook(slab)
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        handle.remove()
+        linear._parameters["weight"] = full

+class _BuildKV(torch.autograd.Function):
+    """``K = [kv[..., :qk] | k_pos]`` (``k_pos`` broadcast over heads) and ``V = kv[..., qk:]``.
+
+    Strided copies in both directions: ``torch.cat`` copies the stride-0 operand element by
+    element, the backward of plain ``copy_`` into slices clones ``dK`` twice, and ``split``'s
+    backward concatenates the strided ``dK`` slice with ``dV`` on the unvectorised path.
+    """
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(ctx, kv, k_pos, qk):
+        ctx.qk, ctx.width = qk, kv.shape[-1]
+        key = kv.new_empty(*kv.shape[:-1], qk + k_pos.shape[-1])
+        key[..., :qk].copy_(kv[..., :qk])
+        key[..., qk:].copy_(k_pos.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, kv.shape[1], -1))
+        return key, kv[..., qk:].contiguous()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def backward(ctx, dk, dv):
+        qk = ctx.qk
+        dkv = dk.new_empty(*dk.shape[:-1], ctx.width)
+        dkv[..., :qk].copy_(dk[..., :qk])
+        dkv[..., qk:].copy_(dv)
+        return dkv, dk[..., qk:].sum(1), None
+

+class _LatentCPRingAttention(torch.autograd.Function):
+    """Latent-KV ring attention over the zigzag schedule.
+
+    Saves ``(q, latent received last, out, lse)``; backward recomputes the KV up-projection of
+    every owner from the re-circulated latents and calls the attention backward with the final
+    merged ``out``/``lse`` (the kernel then forms the global softmax probabilities of its block, so
+    no per-step state and no correction are needed). The up-projection parameters are inputs of
+    this function and receive their gradient once, from ``backward``.
+    """
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(ctx, q, z, module, plan, ring, attn_fwd, attn_bwd, scale, *up_params):
+        fp8 = FP8GlobalStateManager.is_fp8_enabled()
+        slab = module._slab  # this rank's rows of the up-projection weight (a2a modes), or None
+        rows, valid = plan.rows, plan.valid
+        q_u = q.index_select(0, rows) if rows is not None else None
+        pad = None if valid is None else (~valid).unsqueeze(-1)  # [T, 1] broadcast over heads
+        pad_u = pad.index_select(0, rows) if (pad is not None and rows is not None) else None
+        two_stream = module.config.mla_latent_cp_two_stream
+        streams, merged, up_done = _streams(two_stream), torch.cuda.Event(), torch.cuda.Event()
+        out = lse = out_u = lse_u = None
+        rng_states, reqs = [], []
+        for i, step in enumerate(plan.steps):
+            stream, z_cur = streams[i % 2], z if i == 0 else z_nxt
+            with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+                for req in reqs:
+                    req.wait()  # this step's latent has arrived (ordered on this stream)
+                if i < ring.size - 1:
+                    z_nxt = torch.empty_like(
+                        z
+                    )  # on the posting stream: NCCL orders its write after it
+                    reqs = _p2p(ring, [z_cur], [z_nxt], forward=True)
+                z_cur.record_stream(stream)  # read here, freed to the other stream's pool later
+                # TE calls are serialised across the streams: one cuBLAS workspace per device
+                # (get_cublas_workspace is lru_cached) and the per-microbatch fp8 weight cache.
+                stream.wait_event(up_done)
+                with torch.no_grad(), _te_recompute_ctx(fp8, recompute_phase=False):
+                    k, v = module._expand_kv(z_cur, slab)
+                stream.record_event(up_done)
+                out_i, lse_i, rng_i = attn_fwd(q_u if step.upper else q, k, v, step, scale)
+                del k, v
+                rng_states.append(rng_i)
+                if pad is not None:
+                    lse_i.masked_fill_(pad_u if step.upper else pad, 0.0)
+                # The in-place merges are ordered across the two streams by one event.
+                stream.wait_event(merged)
+                if i == 0:
+                    out, lse = (out_i.float(), lse_i.clone()) if ring.size > 1 else (out_i, lse_i)
+                elif not step.upper:
+                    _merge(out, lse, out_i, lse_i)
+                else:
+                    if out_u is None:
+                        out_u, lse_u = out.index_select(0, rows), lse.index_select(0, rows)
+                    _merge(out_u, lse_u, out_i, lse_i)
+                stream.record_event(merged)
+        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(streams[1])
+        if out_u is not None:
+            out.index_copy_(0, rows, out_u)
+            lse.index_copy_(0, rows, lse_u)
+        out = out.to(q.dtype)
+        ctx.save_for_backward(q, z_cur, out, lse)
+        ctx.module, ctx.plan, ctx.ring, ctx.attn_bwd = module, plan, ring, attn_bwd
+        ctx.scale, ctx.rng_states, ctx.fp8, ctx.params = scale, rng_states, fp8, up_params
+        # The slab is the recompute graph's leaf for the up-projection weight in backward, and
+        # TE's fused wgrad reads its main_grad through a weakref: ctx keeps it alive.
+        ctx.slab = slab
+        ctx.fp8_recipe = FP8GlobalStateManager.get_fp8_recipe() if fp8 else None
+        return out
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def backward(ctx, dout):
+        q, z_last, out, lse = ctx.saved_tensors
+        module, plan, ring, scale = ctx.module, ctx.plan, ctx.ring, ctx.scale
+        params, slab = ctx.params, ctx.slab
+        weight = module.linear_kv_up_proj.weight
+        leaves = [slab.param if (slab is not None and p is weight) else p for p in params]
+        det = module.config.deterministic_mode
+        dout = dout.contiguous()
+        rows = plan.rows
+        full = (q, out, dout, lse)
+        dq = torch.zeros(q.shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
+        if rows is not None:
+            upper = tuple(t.index_select(0, rows) for t in full)
+            dq_u = torch.zeros(upper[0].shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
+        zb = [torch.empty_like(z_last), torch.empty_like(z_last)]
+        dzb = [torch.zeros_like(z_last, dtype=torch.float32) for _ in range(2)]
+        grads_p = [None] * len(params)
+        reqs = []
+        last = ring.size - 1
+        for i in range(ring.size):
+            # Latents travel backwards around the ring; the dlatent of the owner processed at this
+            # step arrives one hop behind its latent and is forwarded after this rank's addition.
+            z_cur = z_last if i == 0 else zb[(i - 1) % 2]
+            if last > 0:
+                sends, recvs = [dzb[(i - 1) % 2]], [dzb[i % 2]]
+                if i < last:
+                    sends, recvs = [z_cur] + sends, [zb[i % 2]] + recvs
+                reqs = _p2p(ring, sends, recvs, forward=False)
+            step = plan.steps[last - i]
+            with torch.enable_grad(), fp8_autocast(enabled=ctx.fp8, fp8_recipe=ctx.fp8_recipe):
+                with _te_recompute_ctx(ctx.fp8, recompute_phase=True):
+                    z_j = z_cur.detach().requires_grad_()
+                    k, v = module._expand_kv(z_j, slab)
+            q_s, out_s, dout_s, lse_s = upper if step.upper else full
+            rng = ctx.rng_states[last - i]
+            dq_i, dk, dv = ctx.attn_bwd(q_s, k, v, out_s, dout_s, lse_s, rng, step, scale, det)
+            (dq_u if step.upper else dq).add_(dq_i)
+            # No AccumulateGrad fires here; TE still computes the weight gradient (fused into
+            # main_grad, or returned) because the parameters require grad.
+            grads = torch.autograd.grad((k, v), (z_j, *leaves), (dk, dv), allow_unused=True)
+            del k, v, dk, dv, dq_i
+            for n, g in enumerate(grads[1:]):
+                if g is None:
+                    continue
+                if getattr(leaves[n], "grad_added_to_main_grad", False):
+                    grads_p[n] = g  # already in main_grad; keep TE's dummy as the old path does
+                elif grads_p[n] is None:
+                    grads_p[n] = g.float()
+                else:
+                    grads_p[n].add_(g)
+            for req in reqs:
+                req.wait()
+            dzb[i % 2].add_(grads[0])
+        if rows is not None:
+            dq.index_add_(0, rows, dq_u)
+        dparams = []
+        for p, leaf, g in zip(params, leaves, grads_p):
+            if g is None:  # keep the outer AccumulateGrad (and the DDP hook) firing
+                g = torch.zeros_like(p)
+            elif leaf is not p:  # the slab's gradient belongs to rows [r0, r1) of the full weight
+                full = torch.zeros(p.shape, dtype=g.dtype, device=g.device)
+                if getattr(leaf, "grad_added_to_main_grad", False):
+                    p.grad_added_to_main_grad = True  # TE accumulated into main_grad[r0:r1]
+                else:
+                    full[slab.r0 : slab.r1] = g
+                g = full
+            dparams.append(g.to(p.dtype))
+        dz = dzb[last % 2]
+        return (dq.to(q.dtype), dz.to(z_last.dtype), *([None] * 6), *dparams)
+

+        backends = tuple(

+        # The layer passes cp_comm_type only when CP is on; the config holds it otherwise (a list

+                    hcp[0].rank(),
+                    hcp[1].rank(),
+                    hcp[0].size(),
+                )
+                ok = (
+                    A * hcp[1].size() == cp.size()
+                    and dist.get_process_group_ranks(hcp[0]) == ranks[p * A : (p + 1) * A]

+    def _expand_kv(self, latent, slab=None):

+    ), f"{what}: mean|d|={diff.mean().item():.3e} > {mre}*mean|ref|={mre * mean_ref:.3e}"
+
+
+def _compare_param_grads(new, ref, cp_group, tp_group, grad_tol):
+    """Per-rank partial weight gradients differ between the paths (the up-projection runs on
+    other ranks' latents, its norm on the whole local sequence with this TP rank's partial
+    gradient, a2a ranks on their head slice); they agree after the reductions DDP performs: CP for
+    every parameter, TP for the sequence-parallel (replicated) norm weights."""
+    ref_params = dict(ref.named_parameters())
+    for name, param in new.named_parameters():
+        if param.grad is None:
+            assert ref_params[name].grad is None, name
+            continue
+        # With gradient_accumulation_fusion TE accumulated into main_grad and flagged the param.
+        fused = getattr(param, "grad_added_to_main_grad", False)
+        new_grad = (param.main_grad if fused else param.grad).float().clone()
+        ref_grad = ref_params[name].grad.float().clone()
+        groups = [cp_group] + ([tp_group] if getattr(param, "sequence_parallel", False) else [])
+        for group in groups:
+            dist.all_reduce(new_grad, group=group)
+            dist.all_reduce(ref_grad, group=group)
+        _assert_close(new_grad, ref_grad, *grad_tol, name)
+

+def _run_parity(
+    tp,
+    cp,
+    padded,
+    dynamic=False,
+    kv_norm=False,
+    fp8=False,
+    fp8_param=False,
+    two_stream=False,
+    comm="p2p",
+    a2a=1,
+    heads=HEADS,
+    qk_head_dim=QK_HEAD_DIM,
+    v_head_dim=V_HEAD_DIM,
+    kv_channels=None,
+    fused_wgrad=False,
+):
+    """Old TE-CP MLA (p2p ring) vs MLAWithLatentCP on identical weights, inputs and upstream
+    gradient; ``comm``/``a2a`` select the new path's communication scheme, ``fused_wgrad`` runs
+    the new module with TE's fused weight-gradient accumulation into a manual ``main_grad``,
+    ``fp8_param`` builds both modules with MXFP8 parameters (``fp8_model_init``)."""
+    dims = dict(
+        num_attention_heads=heads,
+        qk_head_dim=qk_head_dim,
+        v_head_dim=v_head_dim,
+        kv_channels=kv_channels,
+    )
+    world = tp * cp
+    if Utils.world_size < world or Utils.world_size % world != 0:
+        pytest.skip(f"Needs a multiple of {world} CUDA ranks.")
+    Utils.initialize_model_parallel(
+        tp,
+        1,
+        context_parallel_size=cp,
+        dynamic_context_parallel=dynamic,
+        hierarchical_context_parallel_sizes=_hcp_sizes(comm, cp, a2a),
+    )
+    try:
+        cp_group = parallel_state.get_context_parallel_group()
+        tp_group = parallel_state.get_tensor_model_parallel_group()
+        tp_cp_group = parallel_state.get_tensor_and_context_parallel_group()
+        eff_group, eff_cp, extra = cp_group, cp, {}
+        if dynamic:
+            # A microbatch scheduled on a dynamic CP group of 2 inside the static CP group.
+            eff_group = parallel_state.get_dynamic_data_context_parallel_groups(group_size=2)
+            eff_cp = 2
+            extra = dict(local_cp_size=2, cp_group=eff_group)
+        device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
+        cp_rank, tp_rank = eff_group.rank(), tp_group.rank()
+        tokens = TOTAL_TOKENS // eff_cp
+
+        spec = _attention_spec(kv_norm)
+        precision = dict(fp8="e4m3", fp8_recipe="mxfp8") if fp8 else {}
+        if fp8_param:  # TE creates the parameters quantized, in params_dtype
+            precision.update(fp8_param=True, params_dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        ref_config = _make_config(tp, cp, mla_latent_cp=False, **dims, **precision)
+        new_config = _make_config(
+            tp,
+            cp,
+            **dims,
+            mla_latent_cp_two_stream=two_stream,
+            cp_comm_type=comm,
+            hierarchical_context_parallel_sizes=_hcp_sizes(comm, cp, a2a),
+            gradient_accumulation_fusion=fused_wgrad,
+            **precision,
+        )
+        # The full collection carries the hierarchical groups (as TransformerLayer passes it).
+        pgs = ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups()
+        with get_fp8_context(new_config, is_init=True):  # fp8_model_init under fp8_param
+            ref = _build(spec, ref_config)
+            new = _build(apply_mla_latent_cp_spec(spec), new_config, pg_collection=pgs)
+        assert isinstance(new, MLAWithLatentCP) and isinstance(new.core_attention, IdentityOp)
+        assert new.cp_comm_type == comm
+        new.load_state_dict(ref.state_dict(), strict=False)
+        if fused_wgrad:  # what DDP provides: an fp32 main_grad and the flag TE sets when it fused
+            for p in new.parameters():
+                p.main_grad = torch.zeros(p.shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=p.device)
+                p.grad_added_to_main_grad = False
+
+        torch.manual_seed(7)
+        full_hidden = torch.randn(TOTAL_TOKENS, 1, HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+        full_grad = torch.randn_like(full_hidden)
+        zigzag = _thd_sp_shard_token_indices(CU_SEQLENS_PADDED, eff_cp, cp_rank, tp, tp_rank).to(
+            device
+        )
+        ref_in = full_hidden.index_select(0, zigzag).requires_grad_(True)
+        with force_cudnn, no_v_pad, get_fp8_context(new_config):
+            try:
+                ref_out, _ = ref(ref_in, None, packed_seq_params=_packed(padded, **extra))
+            except ValueError as error:
+                if "No dot product attention backend" not in str(error):
+                    raise
+                pytest.skip("TE has no backend for padded THD MLA on this build (reference path)")
+            ref_out.mul(full_grad.index_select(0, zigzag)).sum().backward()
+
+        new_idx, new_psp = zigzag, _packed(padded, **extra)
+        new_in = full_hidden.index_select(0, new_idx).requires_grad_(True)
+        saved_shapes, hook_fires = [], []
+        new.linear_kv_up_proj.weight.register_post_accumulate_grad_hook(
+            lambda p: hook_fires.append(1)
+        )
+
+        def pack(t):
+            saved_shapes.append(tuple(t.shape))
+            return t
+
+        save_hooks = torch.autograd.graph.saved_tensors_hooks(pack, lambda t: t)
+        with save_hooks, get_fp8_context(new_config):
+            new_out, _ = new(new_in, None, packed_seq_params=new_psp)
+        new_out.mul(full_grad.index_select(0, new_idx)).sum().backward()
+        if kv_norm:  # the separate norm is differentiated inside the ring (not fused into TE)
+            assert new.kv_layernorm.weight.grad is not None
+
+        # The memory property: only the query (and the output) are saved, never K/V. With an a2a
+        # group the ring saves the exchanged query (A times the tokens, H/A heads), not `query`.
+        heads_tp = heads // tp
+        q_shape = (tokens, heads_tp, qk_head_dim + POS_DIM)
+        if a2a > 1:
+            q_x = (a2a * tokens, heads_tp // a2a, q_shape[-1])
+            out_x = (a2a * tokens, heads_tp // a2a, v_head_dim)
+            same = q_x == out_x  # qk + pos == v: the saved ring output has the query's shape
+            assert saved_shapes.count(q_x) == 1 + same, saved_shapes
+            assert saved_shapes.count(q_shape) == 0, saved_shapes
+            assert saved_shapes.count(out_x) <= 1 + same, saved_shapes
+        else:
+            assert saved_shapes.count(q_shape) <= 1, saved_shapes
+            assert saved_shapes.count((tokens, heads_tp, v_head_dim)) <= 1, saved_shapes
+        # The up-projection weight accumulates its gradient exactly once per microbatch.
+        assert len(hook_fires) == 1
+
+        # Both paths quantize the forward identically, so the output bound is the bf16 one. In the
+        # backward, MXFP8 (E4M3, 3 mantissa bits) quantizes every rank's partial dK/dV before the
+        # up-projection in the ring but their CP sum once in TE's ring, so the two paths carry
+        # independent rounding noise of the same size: measured 8e-2 max / 5e-2 mean relative on
+        # GB300 (tp=2, cp=2) against <= 1e-2 measured in bf16.
+        out_tol = (1e-2, 2e-2)
+        grad_tol = (1.5e-1, 1e-1) if fp8 else (2e-2, 3e-2)
+        full_ref = _gather_full_thd(ref_out, zigzag, TOTAL_TOKENS, tp_cp_group)
+        full_new = _gather_full_thd(new_out, new_idx, TOTAL_TOKENS, tp_cp_group)
+        _assert_close(full_new, full_ref, *out_tol, "output")
+        full_ref_grad = _gather_full_thd(ref_in.grad, zigzag, TOTAL_TOKENS, tp_cp_group)
+        full_new_grad = _gather_full_thd(new_in.grad, new_idx, TOTAL_TOKENS, tp_cp_group)
+        _assert_close(full_new_grad, full_ref_grad, *grad_tol, "input grad")
+        _compare_param_grads(new, ref, cp_group, tp_group, grad_tol)
+    finally:
+        Utils.destroy_model_parallel()
+
+
+# (tp, cp, cp_comm_type, a2a group size, padded); the last four need 8 GPUs.
+A2A_CASES = (
+    (1, 4, "a2a+p2p", 2, False),
+    (1, 4, "a2a+p2p", 2, True),
+    (1, 4, "a2a", 4, False),
+    (1, 4, "a2a", 4, True),
+    (2, 2, "a2a", 2, False),
+    (2, 4, "a2a+p2p", 2, False),
+    (1, 8, "a2a+p2p", 2, False),
+    (1, 8, "a2a+p2p", 4, True),
+    (1, 8, "a2a", 8, True),
+)

+
+    qf, kf, vf = (
+        t.float().transpose(0, 1).contiguous().requires_grad_(True) for t in (q, k, v)
+    )  # [h, n, d]
+    scores = scale * qf @ kf[:, : n // 2].transpose(1, 2)
+    probs = scores.softmax(-1)
+    ref_out = probs @ vf[:, : n // 2]
+    ref_lse = torch.logsumexp(scores, -1)
+    ref_out.backward(dout.float().transpose(0, 1))
+    _assert_close(out.transpose(0, 1), ref_out, 2e-2, 2e-2, "out")
+    _assert_close(lse.transpose(0, 1), ref_lse, 1e-2, 1e-2, "lse")
+    _assert_close(dq.transpose(0, 1), qf.grad, 2e-2, 3e-2, "dq")
+    _assert_close(dk.transpose(0, 1), kf.grad, 2e-2, 3e-2, "dk")
+    _assert_close(dv.transpose(0, 1), vf.grad, 2e-2, 3e-2, "dv")
+    assert torch.equal(dk[n // 2 :], torch.zeros_like(dk[n // 2 :]))
+    assert torch.equal(dv[n // 2 :], torch.zeros_like(dv[n // 2 :]))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(("cp", "a2a"), ((16, 4), (16, 8), (16, 2), (8, 4), (4, 4)))
+def test_a2a_permutation_matches_chunk_bookkeeping(cp, a2a):
+    """The gather over the a2a group (rank-major) permuted with ``_a2a_permutation`` is the
+    sequence order of the p2p zigzag: for every p2p rank, the global chunk ids of both halves are
+    ascending and contiguous (natural order when the a2a group is the whole CP group)."""
+    lengths = [2 * cp * n for n in (1, 3, 2, 4)]
+    cup = torch.tensor([0] + list(itertools.accumulate(lengths)), dtype=torch.int32)
+    psp = PackedSeqParams(
+        qkv_format="thd", cu_seqlens_q=cup, cu_seqlens_q_padded=cup, max_seqlen_q=max(lengths)
+    )
+    tokens = cup[-1].item() // cp
+    perm, inv = mla_latent_cp._a2a_permutation(psp, cp, a2a, tokens)
+    assert torch.equal(perm.index_select(0, inv), torch.arange(a2a * tokens))
+
+    def chunks(rank_chunks):  # global token ids of the given chunk ids, sequence by sequence
+        ids = []
+        for s0, s1 in zip(cup[:-1].tolist(), cup[1:].tolist()):
+            c = (s1 - s0) // (2 * cp)
+            for first, last in rank_chunks:
+                ids += list(range(s0 + first * c, s0 + (last + 1) * c))
+        return torch.tensor(ids)
+
+    for p in range(cp // a2a):
+        # Rank r holds chunks r and 2P-1-r; the a2a group of p2p rank p is ranks pA .. pA+A-1.
+        gathered = torch.cat(
+            [
+                chunks([(r, r), (2 * cp - 1 - r, 2 * cp - 1 - r)])
+                for r in range(p * a2a, (p + 1) * a2a)
+            ]
+        )
+        expected = chunks(
+            [(p * a2a, (p + 1) * a2a - 1), (2 * cp - (p + 1) * a2a, 2 * cp - 1 - p * a2a)]
+        )
+        assert torch.equal(gathered.index_select(0, perm), expected), (cp, a2a, p)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "overrides",
+    (
+        dict(multi_latent_attention=False),
+        dict(cp_comm_type="all_gather"),
+        dict(cp_comm_type="a2a+p2p"),  # no hierarchical sizes
+        dict(
+            cp_comm_type="a2a+p2p",
+            context_parallel_size=4,
+            hierarchical_context_parallel_sizes=[2, 4],
+        ),
+        dict(

+            tensor_model_parallel_size=4,
+            sequence_parallel=True,

+        dict(cp_comm_type="a2a", dynamic_context_parallel=True),

+@requires_te
+def test_module_rejections():
+    Utils.initialize_model_parallel(1, 1)
+    try:
+        spec = apply_mla_latent_cp_spec(_attention_spec())
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="mla_latent_cp=True"):
+            _build(spec, _make_config(1, 1, mla_latent_cp=False))
+        local = _attention_spec(kv_norm=True)
+        local.submodules.linear_kv_up_proj = ColumnParallelLinear
+        with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="Transformer Engine linear"):
+            _build(apply_mla_latent_cp_spec(local), _make_config(1, 1))
+        # a2a+p2p needs the hierarchical groups; a collection without them is rejected.
+        no_hcp = ProcessGroupCollection(
+            tp=parallel_state.get_tensor_model_parallel_group(),
+            cp=parallel_state.get_context_parallel_group(),

+        )
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="hcp"):
+            _build(spec, hier, cp_comm_type="a2a+p2p", pg_collection=no_hcp)
+        module = _build(spec, _make_config(1, 1))
+        x = torch.randn(16, 1, HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")

+        assert len(layer_specs) == 2
+        for layer_spec in layer_specs:
+            attention = layer_spec.submodules.self_attention
+            assert attention.module is module and attention.submodules.core_attention is core
+        stack = HybridStack(  # one MLA layer ('+'), as the Kimi hybrid pattern builds it

+            layer_type_list=["+"],
+            post_layer_norm=False,
+            pg_collection=ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups(),

+        assert type(stack.layers[0].self_attention) is module
+        assert type(stack.layers[0].self_attention.core_attention) is core
